title: Your Brain Deletes Most Of What You Experience #Shorts
description:
Every second your senses deliver far more information than you could ever process, so almost all of it is discarded before you notice.

A day with nothing new in it will be deleted almost entirely. That is not a memory flaw. That is the design.

Made with AI assistance.

#facts #science #psychology #education #learn

scenes.narration: Every second your senses deliver far more information than you could ever process, so almost all of it is discarded before you notice.
In experiments, roughly half of viewers fail to notice a large unexpected event when their attention is counting something else.
You can walk the same route for years and not remember a detail of it. Nothing triggered a reason to keep it.
Traumatic memories work the same way. The recording system keeps the emotion and drops the context.
Novelty, emotion and attention all mark a moment as worth keeping. You can bias the system on purpose.
A day with nothing new in it will be deleted almost entirely. That is not a memory flaw. That is the design.
